rationale: Roberts is best positioned to assign and keep an 8-1 coalition together with a narrow, regulation-text holding applying §§ 541.602(a) and 541.604(b) and avoiding the ultra vires question. Thomas is likely to write alone to press the statutory/delegation objection, while one or more textualist conservatives (especially Gorsuch/Barrett/Kavanaugh) may add a short concurrence flagging that the regulation’s validity is not decided.
